newsitem.title: USA: Fossil Q3 sales may rise 20 pct vs yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Fossil Q3 sales may rise 20 pct vs yr ago.

text.p: Fossil Inc said on Thursday that strong order flows could lift its consolidated net sales for the third quarter to more than $52 million, or 20 percent higher than in the same period last year.
The Fossil leather-goods business gained more momentum and sales of women's handbags and small leather goods were particularly strong, the company said in a statement.
Earnings might not reflect sales growth in third quarter partly because of start-up costs for new operations.
Fossil said earnings for the three months ending September 30 would likely range between $0.25 and $0.28 per share, against $0.21 the same period last year.

The company's diversification into outlet stores and growing presence in France, Britain and Japan were helping sales, it said. But associated start-up costs had increased cash expenditure and lowered operating profits.
The Fossil watch brand is growing in the United States, it said. The company expects to announce a licensing agreement to produce and sell watches under a brand name recognized worldwide.
